name: desktop
title: Desktop
description: A whole site as a Mac OS X 10.1 desktop, from a Site (lib/content.ts): the Finder in three views with a Kind filter, marquee, search and Back; TextEdit documents with an outline; Preview and QuickTime windows; the About box with its panes; the menu bar, desktop icons and Dock — every window dragged, resized, zoomed and minimised through the genie.

files.content: /** A file in public/, under the path the site is served from: "" on Vercel, * "/Patina" on GitHub Pages without a custom domain (next.config.ts sets it). Next adds the prefix to * its own links and scripts, not to a plain or a CSS url(). */ export const asset = (path: string) => `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_PATH ?? ""}${path}`

/**
 * The desktop's icons: Olivia's own artwork (apps/web/public/icons/), 128px
 * on the longer side, as near-lossless WebP, inlined as data URIs so they
 * install with the source.
 * Generated by scripts/desktop-icons.mjs — edit the PNGs and run it again.
 */
